priorities.summary: AutoGPT Platform versions 0.6.26 through 0.7.4 ship a publicly known, hardcoded default JWT verification key, so anyone who knows the secret can forge valid tokens for any user or for the admin role and bypass authentication without user interaction. This issue is fixed in version 0.8.0.
priorities.plain: AutoGPT lets anyone forge a login for any account, including admins — upgrade to version 0.8.0 now.

priorities.summary: Improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('path traversal') in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to execute code over a network. Microsoft lists SharePoint Server Subscription Edition builds from 16.0.0 before 16.0.20326.20190 as affected, alongside SharePoint Online.
priorities.plain: Microsoft SharePoint lets a logged-in attacker run code on the server — apply the Microsoft security update now.
priorities.product: Microsoft SharePoint Online / Microsoft SharePoint Server Subscription Edition

priorities.summary: A vulnerability in the database service of Cisco Expressway Series, due to persistent cookies and insufficient validation of client certificates when TLS Verify Mode is enabled for clustering, allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary operating system commands as root. CISA added it to the KEV catalog on November 20 after reported exploitation; Cisco fixes it in X15.5.20.
priorities.plain: Cisco Expressway lets attackers run commands as the top administrator without logging in and is being exploited — upgrade now.

model.name: Gemini 4 Neon
model.summary: Google introduced Gemini 4 Neon on November 18, bringing frontier-level intelligence with fast end-to-end task completion across complex software engineering, knowledge work and science workflows. It is rolling out in the Gemini API, Gemini for business and paid Gemini app plans.
model.plain: A fast Google AI for coding, analysis and business work that gives teams high-end help without waiting on the slowest top-tier models.
